answer: Each work weaves into a public vine, citing two works by two unrelated authors; a sparrow auditor checks citations are key-signed and real. A closed-loop ring burns every bond in it. Each identity locks 70 credits and pays 40 plus two citations at 25 each, so one fake pays 90; 1,000 fakes pay 90,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool, since each citation must wander to a different vine. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its bond.
